# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner | Orchestrates RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner | Runs one complete TDD cycle with retries and learning |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod | LanguagePod for Python: code generation via WorkerAgent, execution via PodmanOrchestrator |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod | LanguagePod for Go: code generation and execution in Go containers |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod | LanguagePod for TypeScript: code generation and execution in TypeScript containers |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent | Generates code for RED, GREEN, REFACTOR phases using LLM |
| TypeScriptWorkerAgent | src/agents/typescript_worker_agent | TypeScript-specific code generation with fallback |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner | Determines the next test increment using LLM |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator | Stateless sidecar execution layer supporting file pulse and security checks |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner | Rootless Podman container lifecycle manager |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner | Multi-language TDD orchestrator using PodFactory |
| PodFactory | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner | Creates LanguagePod instances for a given language |
| EnsembleBuildRunner | src/agents/ensemble_build | Drives multi-candidate blind build for one feature |
| GherkinExtractionAgent | src/agents/gherkin_extraction_agent | Reverse engineers Gherkin scenarios from existing code and tests |
| CodeAnalyzer | src/agents/gherkin_extraction_agent | Analyzes Python code to extract structure and APIs |
| TestAnalyzer | src/agents/gherkin_extraction_agent | Analyzes test code to extract test scenarios |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before RED phase |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager | Core playbook operations: creation, updates, merging, retrieval |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant bullets |
| BulletDeduplicator | src/playbook/deduplication | Semantic deduplication of bullets using embedding similarity |
| BulletClusterer | src/playbook/clustering | DBSCAN-based clustering for playbook bullets |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever | CGR³: Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason pipeline |
| ContextScorer | src/retrieval/context_scorer | Scores bullets against request context across multiple dimensions |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service | Central knowledge retrieval service for all code generation |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module | Analyzes generator performance and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module | Synthesizes insights into playbook updates |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments, PostgreSQL with SQLite fallback |
| PlaybookRepository | src/storage/repository | PostgreSQL repository for playbooks and bullets with pgvector |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers |
| EmbeddingService | src/utils/embedding | Local embedding generation using sentence-transformers |
| ContextMap | src/utils/context_map | AST-based context map for test-to-implementation navigation |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator | Extracts metrics from audit trail for agent evaluation |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store | Append-only audit event store with hash chain integrity |
| LocalAuditClient | src/audit/local_client | Audit client that writes directly to local SQLite database |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency | Computes token efficiency scores from LanguagePod run data |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src/analytics/success_rate_calculator | Measures experiment success rates across the system |
| BlindEvaluator | src/benchmark/blind_evaluation | Scores outputs without knowing which agent produced them |
| PlaybookReliabilityAnalyzer | src/reliability/playbook_analyzer | Correlates bullet retrieval with first-pass GREEN outcomes |
| TDDCycleAnalyzer | src/reliability/tdd_cycle_analyzer | Measures first-pass GREEN rate and trend over time |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant PlaybookMgr as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    Runner->>Planner: next_increment(feature)
    Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement

    loop for each cycle
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        act Cycle

        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        act Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        act Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        LLM-->>Worker: response
        deact Worker
        Worker-->>Pod: code
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
        act Orchestrator
        Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        Container-->>Orchestrator: result
        deact Orchestrator
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deact Pod

        alt RED aborted or never pulsed
            Pod-->>Cycle: error
        else RED passed
            Pod-->>Cycle: success
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
            act Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
            act Worker
            Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
            LLM-->>Worker: response
            deact Worker
            Worker-->>Pod: code
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
            Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse
            Container-->>Orchestrator: result
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deact Pod

            alt GREEN passed
                Pod-->>Cycle: success
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                act Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec)
                Worker->>LLM: generate
                LLM-->>Worker: response
                Worker-->>Pod: code
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse
                Container-->>Orchestrator: result
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deact Pod
                Pod-->>Cycle: success
            else GREEN failed
                loop retry up to max_green_attempts
                    Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec with error feedback)
                    Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation
                    Worker->>LLM: generate
                    LLM-->>Worker: response
                    Worker-->>Pod: code
                    Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse
                    Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse
                    Container-->>Orchestrator: result
                    Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                    alt GREEN passed
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            alt cycle succeeded and learning enabled
                Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, generator_output, environment_feedback)
                Reflector->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                Curator->>PlaybookMgr: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                PlaybookMgr-->>Curator: added_bullets
                Curator-->>Reflector: curator_output
                Reflector-->>Cycle: learned_bullets
            end

            Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        end
        deact Cycle
    end
```
